description: Maestro conformance matrix for ennio. Each row pins one command/selector/modifier behavior against documented Maestro semantics. `status` is the CURRENT ennio behavior; `targetPhase` is the plan phase that converges it. Device-free rows are asserted by maestro-parser.test.ts; deviceBacked rows by e2e/conformance/run-suite.sh. Source of truth: docs/maestro-parity.md.

statusLegend.divergent: ennio intentionally or unintentionally differs (see note)
statusLegend.fragile: works by heuristic that can misfire (target for removal)

rows.case: text: "Sign In" matches an element whose label is exactly "Sign In"
rows.maestro: regex match of the whole string; plain text with no metachars matches literally
rows.ennioCurrent: literal case-insensitive substring contains (find_by_text), regex fallback off

rows.case: text: "Price: $5 (USD)" — literal content that contains regex metacharacters $ ( )
rows.maestro: treated as a regex; the literal would need escaping. Documented behavior: regex.
rows.ennioCurrent: isRegexText() sniff sees $ ( ) and switches to regex => "$5" anchors end-of-string, "(USD)" is a group => MISMATCH against literal on-screen text
rows.note: Phase 1 added an explicit `literal: true` escape hatch (textMatchMode) so this is now author-fixable; the unannotated default still sniffs until Phase 2 flips it per-profile.

rows.case: literal: true forces a literal substring even for metachar content
rows.maestro: n/a (ennio extension); the Maestro-faithful path is to escape the regex, this is the ergonomic equivalent
rows.ennioCurrent: textMatchMode honors explicit literal:/regex: over the sniff (Phase 1)

rows.case: regex pattern "users[,]? or feeds" must match "users or feeds" and "users, or feeds"
rows.ennioCurrent: isRegexText() sees [,]? => regex branch => matches

rows.case: text: "Done" must NOT match "Done editing" (Maestro anchors the whole string)
rows.maestro: whole-string regex => "Done" matches only "Done", not "Done editing"
rows.ennioCurrent: maestro profile anchors the pattern whole-string (textMatchArgs ^(?:…)$); resilient keeps legacy substring
rows.note: Closed under maestro (Phase 6, CLI-side anchoring over the existing native regex path). Resilient keeps substring for the migration window.

rows.case: id is a regex in Maestro: id: "item-.*" matches item-1
rows.ennioCurrent: id is exact-match (isEqualToString) on accessibilityIdentifier — NOT regex
rows.note: Remaining native gap. id is matched by an exact hash lookup in the testID index on BOTH platforms; regex-id needs a coordinated EnnioFinder.mm + EnnioAgent.java change and a rebuild of both binaries to keep iOS/Android parity. Deferred — an iOS-only change would itself create a new cross-platform divergence.

rows.case: index: 2 picks the 3rd match (0-based), top-to-bottom by Y
rows.ennioCurrent: find_by_testid_nth, sorted top-to-bottom by window Y

rows.case: childOf scopes the match under a parent testID
rows.ennioCurrent: find_child_by_testid; returns null if parent missing (no flat fallback)

rows.case: below/above/leftOf/rightOf anchor selectors
rows.maestro: position-relative matching combined with AND logic
rows.ennioCurrent: parsed into MaestroSelector; runner support varies — assert coverage

rows.case: traits: [text|long-text|square], width/height/tolerance
rows.ennioCurrent: fields exist on MaestroSelector; runner coverage unverified

rows.case: optional: true on ANY command — missing element skips the step instead of failing
rows.ennioCurrent: implemented at the dispatch seam (Phase 3): extractModifiers + shared evaluateCondition

rows.case: label: "step name" on any command shows in the report
rows.ennioCurrent: implemented at the dispatch seam (Phase 3): extractModifiers + shared evaluateCondition

rows.case: when: { visible } gates a command
rows.ennioCurrent: implemented at the dispatch seam (Phase 3): extractModifiers + shared evaluateCondition

rows.case: when: { platform: iOS } and when: { true: ${expr} }
rows.ennioCurrent: implemented at the dispatch seam (Phase 3): extractModifiers + shared evaluateCondition

rows.case: repeat: { times: N, commands }
rows.ennioCurrent: supported

rows.case: repeat: { while: <condition>, commands }
rows.maestro: loop while condition holds, optionally combined with times
rows.ennioCurrent: implemented at the dispatch seam (Phase 3): extractModifiers + shared evaluateCondition

rows.case: retry: { maxRetries, commands }
rows.ennioCurrent: supported (default maxRetries 3)

rows.case: assertVisible default timeout
rows.ennioCurrent: DEFAULT_WAIT_MS 15000 ms (resilient); maestro profile = 7000 ms
rows.note: Profile-gated. maestro profile ships 7s; resilient keeps 15s for iOS-26 sim.

rows.case: extendedWaitUntil requires explicit timeout, supports visible XOR notVisible
rows.maestro: no default timeout; user must specify
rows.ennioCurrent: supported

rows.case: onFlowStart aborts flow on failure; onFlowComplete runs in finally
rows.ennioCurrent: onFlowStart aborts on failure; onFlowComplete runs in finally (implemented)

rows.case: runFlow.env > flow env: defaults > process.env at runtime
rows.ennioCurrent: single-pass interpolation, per-flow env wins (recent fix)
